tools.name: chess_position_check
tools.description: FREE chess position check: legal moves, check/mate/draw, material, opening. Give a FEN and/or PGN moves. Validates every move, returns the FEN, side to move, all legal moves (SAN), check/checkmate/stalemate/draw status, material and the opening name. Always free. (free, no payment)

tools.name: chess_opening_lookup
tools.description: FREE chess opening lookup: ECO code and name from moves, or search by name. Names the opening for a move sequence or FEN (handles transpositions), or searches ~3,800 named lines by name. Data: lichess chess-openings (CC0). Always free. (free, no payment)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chess_mate_search, chess_best_move · Private data: chess_mate_search, chess_best_move · Public sink: chess_mate_search, chess_best_move.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chess_mate_search, chess_best_move · Private data: chess_mate_search, chess_best_move · Public sink: chess_mate_search, chess_best_move

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
